question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
-- Final verification: ensure the output is exactly as required
-- Check the row count and column count
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_composition
    FROM interest_metrics 
    WHERE month_year IN ('09-2018','10-2018','11-2018','12-2018','01-2019','02-2019','03-2019','04-2019','05-2019','06-2019','07-2019','08-2019')
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, avg_composition,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_per_month AS (
    SELECT r.month_year, r.interest_id, r.avg_composition, im.interest_name
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN interest_map im ON r.interest_id = im.id
    WHERE r.rn = 1
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 
               CASE 
                   WHEN month_year LIKE '%-2018' THEN 1
                   ELSE 2
               END,
               CASE month_year 
                   WHEN '09-2018' THEN 1
                   WHEN '10-2018' THEN 2
                   WHEN '11-2018' THEN 3
                   WHEN '12-2018' THEN 4
                   WHEN '01-2019' THEN 5
                   WHEN '02-2019' THEN 6
                   WHEN '03-2019' THEN 7
                   WHEN '04-2019' THEN 8
                   WHEN '05-2019' THEN 9
                   WHEN '06-2019' THEN 10
                   WHEN '07-2019' THEN 11
                   WHEN '08-2019' THEN 12
               END
           ) as month_seq
    FROM top_per_month
)
SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_name,
    avg_composition as max_index_composition,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_composition) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 6) as rolling_avg_3m,
    LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) as prev_month_interest,
    LAG(avg_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) as prev_month_max_index,
    LAG(interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) as two_months_ago_interest,
    LAG(avg_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) as two_months_ago_max_index
FROM ordered
ORDER BY month_seq;
